author: asukhobo
title: GGUF frontend test_parser.cpp fails to build under C++20 mode (char8_t/std::string mismatch in unicode path concatenation)
signature: error c2676 binary operator std string does not define operator conversion acceptable predefined operator make_path no matching overloaded function found char8_t const object must be initialized|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build - OpenVINO step fails compiling src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp: C2676/C2672/C2737/C3536 around unicode_prefix

key_errors: C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(731): error C2676: binary '+': 'std::string' does not define this operator or a conversion to a type acceptable to the predefined operator
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(731): error C2672: 'ov::util::make_path': no matching overloaded function found
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(731): error C2737: 'unicode_prefix': const object must be initialized
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(733): error C3536: 'unicode_prefix': cannot be used before it is initialized
root_cause: In src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp:731, `ov::util::make_path(m_base + u8"_模型_żółć")` concatenates a std::string (m_base) with a u8-prefixed string literal. Under the C++20 standard mode enabled for this 'Build (C++20, non-blocking)' job (-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20), u8 literals are typed as `const char8_t[]` instead of `const char[]`, so `std::string::operator+` has no overload accepting a char8_t array and MSVC cannot find a viable `operator+` or a matching `ov::util::make_path` overload. The resulting compile error leaves `unicode_prefix` uninitialized, cascading into two more errors. This is a pre-existing source defect unrelated to this PR's actual change (src/plugins/intel_npu/cmake/download_compiler_libs.cmake); it only surfaces on the opt-in, non-blocking C++20 build variant.
reproduction_steps: Configure and build OpenVINO locally with -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20 -DENABLE_OV_GGUF_FRONTEND=ON -DENABLE_TESTS=ON, then build the 'ov_gguf_frontend_tests' target (e.g. `cmake --build . --target ov_gguf_frontend_tests`) with a C++20-conformant compiler (MSVC 14.42+); the same C2676/C2672/C2737/C3536 errors reproduce at test_parser.cpp:731.
recommended_actions: In src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp around line 731, avoid concatenating std::string with a u8 string literal directly: either drop the `u8` prefix (rely on UTF-8 source encoding so the literal stays `const char[]`), or explicitly convert, e.g. `m_base + std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u8"_模型_żółć"))`, or build the path via `std::filesystem::path` concatenation (`/` or `+=` on a path object) instead of `std::string::operator+`.

Add a CI job or local build step that exercises the C++20 configuration (-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20) for GGUF frontend tests before merging unicode-literal changes, since this currently only breaks the non-blocking C++20 variant and has escaped several merges.
Audit other u8"..." literals in src/frontends/gguf/tests for the same char8_t/std::string incompatibility introduced by C++20.
prevention_strategies: Treat the 'Build (C++20, non-blocking)' job's failures as a signal worth fixing promptly even though it is currently non-blocking, since this exact defect has now recurred 4 times over 5 days without a fix landing. Consider a lint rule or clang-tidy check flagging `u8"..."` literals combined with `std::string` arithmetic, and ensure new GGUF frontend tests are also compiled under C++20 locally before submission.
